text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. What a beautiful
morning it is...
The air is so invigorating
as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Since I had the day off, I decided
to
research how to create the perfect
bedtime
routine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At night, I did some light aerobic
exercise and full body stretches, had
some hot milk, and retired at an ideal
time. The result was a perfect night's 
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful day off. Thank you for
the
break.
